item.title: Conduit v4.2.2
item.description:
Conduit 4.2.2 | conduit
## What's Changed * Support Open WebUI 0.12.3 by @cogwheel0 in https://github.com/cogwheel0/conduit/pull/850 * Fix four reported bugs: Direct next to Hermes, MCP tool images, channel thread scrolling, default filters by @cogwheel0 in https://github.com/cogwheel0/conduit/pull/870 * fix/feat: Improve handling for video files in OpenWebUI/chat by @dalgibbard in https://github.com/cogwheel0/conduit/pull/869 * Open the Android assistant on a ready new chat, and keep it after a reboot by @cogwheel0 in https://github.com/cogwheel0/conduit/pull/872 * Mark chats unread from the chat list and show web unread marks in the app by @cogwheel0 in https://github.com/cogwheel0/conduit/pull/874 * Share screenshots and Files documents to Conduit on iOS with their real contents by @cogwheel0 in https://github.com/cogwheel0/conduit/pull/875 * Load chat videos on tap, stop resending generated videos, and fix older chats with videos saved as images by @cogwheel0 in https://github.com/cogwheel0/conduit/pull/876 * Keep server dictation text when stop is tapped while it is transcribing by @cogwheel0 in https://github.com/cogwheel0/conduit/pull/873 * Make the progressive-replacement cadence test independent of timing by @cogwheel0 in https://github.com/cogwheel0/conduit/pull/877 * Close the sidebar when a share opens chat on a phone by @cogwheel0 in https://github.com/cogwheel0/conduit/pull/878 * List a server under its new address once its old one is edited by @cogwheel0 in https://github.com/cogwheel0/conduit/pull/884 * Offer the reasoning-effort picker to every model, send it on explicit opt-in by @michaw23 in https://github.com/cogwheel0/conduit/pull/871 * Share an image from Safari's long-press menu to Conduit as the image by @cogwheel0 in https://github.com/cogwheel0/conduit/pull/885 * Keep long-message context menu actions visible on iOS by @kapily in https://github.com/cogwheel0/conduit/pull/881 * Share responses from the ellipsis menu by @kapily in https://github.com/cogwheel0/conduit/pull/882 * Name a server by its new address on Chat data controls and Personal connections by @cogwheel0 in https://github.com/cogwheel0/conduit/pull/887 * Name a Hermes connection after its new host when its URL is edited by @cogwheel0 in https://github.com/cogwheel0/conduit/pull/889 * Copy the response version on screen by @cogwheel0 in https://github.com/cogwheel0/conduit/pull/888 * Remember which folders are open by saving each toggle to Open WebUI by @cogwheel0 in https://github.com/cogwheel0/conduit/pull/886 * Ask before an Open WebUI function moves the chat to another model by @cogwheel0 in https://github.com/cogwheel0/conduit/pull/890 * Support Open WebUI 0.12.4 by @cogwheel0 in https://github.com/cogwheel0/conduit/pull/891 * Make the chat export share tests wait for staging instead of timing by @cogwheel0 in https://github.com/cogwheel0/conduit/pull/894 * Go back to the chat list from a chat, channel or folder on Android by @cogwheel0 in https://github.com/cogwheel0/conduit/pull/892 * Keep everything said in server dictation, to the last word by @cogwheel0 in https://github.com/cogwheel0/conduit/pull/893
## New Contributors * @dalgibbard made their first contribution in https://github.com/cogwheel0/conduit/pull/869 * @michaw23 made their first contribution in https://github.com/cogwheel0/conduit/pull/871 * @kapily made their first contribution in https://github.com/cogwheel0/conduit/pull/881
**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/cogwheel0/conduit/compare/v4.2.1...v4.2.2

item.title: Conduit v4.2.0
item.description:
Conduit 4.2.0 | conduit
## What's Changed * Add Open WebUI client parity and Advanced UI controls by @cogwheel0 in https://github.com/cogwheel0/conduit/pull/807 * Make everyday Open WebUI features available without Advanced and polish the new screens by @cogwheel0 in https://github.com/cogwheel0/conduit/pull/808 * CI: run steps in parallel, cache Gradle, and trim setup by @cogwheel0 in https://github.com/cogwheel0/conduit/pull/810 * Add Flutter control facades and a narrow platform UI vocabulary (1/5) by @cogwheel0 in https://github.com/cogwheel0/conduit/pull/811 * Enforce the platform UI seam with a shrinking allow-list (2/5) by @cogwheel0 in https://github.com/cogwheel0/conduit/pull/812 * Route settings selection controls through platform UI (3/5) by @cogwheel0 in https://github.com/cogwheel0/conduit/pull/813 * Use platform UI chips for reactions, decisions and folder icons (4/5) by @cogwheel0 in https://github.com/cogwheel0/conduit/pull/814 * Use platform UI controls for launcher loading and Direct retries (5/5) by @cogwheel0 in https://github.com/cogwheel0/conduit/pull/815 * Keep the chosen reasoning effort when the model selector is reopened by @cogwheel0 in https://github.com/cogwheel0/conduit/pull/821 * Store Open WebUI servers and accounts in one registry (1/4) by @cogwheel0 in https://github.com/cogwheel0/conduit/pull/817 * Keep several Open WebUI accounts signed in and switch between them (2/4) by @cogwheel0 in https://github.com/cogwheel0/conduit/pull/818 * Switch, add and sign out of Open WebUI accounts from the profile (3/4) by @cogwheel0 in https://github.com/cogwheel0/conduit/pull/819 * Reach an Open WebUI server through whichever of its addresses answers (4/4) by @cogwheel0 in https://github.com/cogwheel0/conduit/pull/820 * Save several named Hermes connections and switch between them by @cogwheel0 in https://github.com/cogwheel0/conduit/pull/816 * Stop downloading whole chats again when they open by @cogwheel0 in https://github.com/cogwheel0/conduit/pull/826 * Keep the docked iPad sidebar visible to VoiceOver by @cogwheel0 in https://github.com/cogwheel0/conduit/pull/827 * Put every account and connection on one Accounts page, and add them from one sheet by @cogwheel0 in https://github.com/cogwheel0/conduit/pull/828 * Support Open WebUI 0.12 by @cogwheel0 in https://github.com/cogwheel0/conduit/pull/843 * Talk with a realtime voice in calls on Open WebUI, Hermes and Direct by @cogwheel0 in https://github.com/cogwheel0/conduit/pull/842
**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/cogwheel0/conduit/compare/v4.1.9...v4.2.0
